# An if is a select only when both sides can be computed for every lane without
# changing what the scalar loop does: the stored element is read by the condition
# (or both branches store it), every other slice is read by the first condition, the
# condition is a comparison of loop values, and each branch is one assignment to the
# same element. Everything else stays scalar, with the reason.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

loopvec -json .
cmpenv stdout stdout.want

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

// The vector loop would write x back in the lanes where y is not positive.
func StoreUnderOtherCondition(x, y []float32) {
	for i := range x {
		if y[i] > 0 {
			x[i] = 1
		}
	}
}

// b is short in the lanes where a is not positive, and the scalar loop never reads it.
func BranchReadsOtherSlice(dst, a, b []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		if a[i] > 0 {
			dst[i] = b[i]
		} else {
			dst[i] = 0
		}
	}
}

func ElseIfReadsOtherSlice(dst, a, b []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		if a[i] > 0 {
			dst[i] = 1
		} else if b[i] > 0 {
			dst[i] = 2
		} else {
			dst[i] = 3
		}
	}
}

// && skips b[i] when a[i] is not positive.
func AndReadsOtherSlice(x, a, b []float32) {
	for i := range x {
		if a[i] > 0 && b[i] > 0 {
			x[i] = 0
		} else {
			x[i] = 1
		}
	}
}

func InitStatement(x []float32) {
	for i := range x {
		if v := x[i]; v < 0 {
			x[i] = 0
		}
	}
}

func NotAComparison(x []float32, flag bool) {
	for i := range x {
		if flag {
			x[i] = 0
		} else {
			x[i] = 1
		}
	}
}

func TwoStatements(x, y []float32) {
	for i := range x {
		if x[i] < 0 {
			x[i] = 0
			y[i] = 0
		}
	}
}

func DifferentSlices(x, y []float32) {
	for i := range x {
		if x[i] < 0 {
			x[i] = 0
		} else {
			y[i] = 1
		}
	}
}

// The comparison is on float32 and the store is int32.
func MixedTypes(n []int32, f []float32) {
	for i := range n {
		if f[i] > 0 {
			n[i] = 1
		} else {
			n[i] = 2
		}
	}
}
